name: wisenet-chrome-ip-installer
description: WiseNet/Hanwha IPTV discovery extension, plus a Node.js port of its UDP camera discovery protocol (see src/nodejs/, built on the shared SUNAPI wire-format implementation in src/sunapi/). TypeScript sources live under src/ and build to dist/chrome-extension/ + dist/nodejs/ — this package itself is private (the Chrome extension isn't published to npm); dist/nodejs/'s own package.json (name: @melchi45/wisenet-udp-discovery) is the one actually published to GitHub Packages by .github/workflows/publish-npm.yml.

scripts.build:extension: tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc -p src/shared/tsconfig.socket.json && node scripts/substitute-player-extension-ids.js build/shared/scripts/socket.js && tsc -p src/shared/tsconfig.window.json && vite build --config src/shared/vite.config.ts
scripts.start: node scripts/build.js node && node scripts/build.js shared-v2 && node dist/nodejs/examples/server.js
